visual_logic.color_palette: Azure-blue body with a high-contrast black 'mask' around the eyes and a pale cream underbelly, running continuously along its horizontal profile.
visual_logic.action: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. The swift darting motion is stabilized parallel to the frame boundaries.
visual_logic.environment: Bright azure water with a high-albedo chalky white seafloor visible below. The school of silver clay fish is shifted entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a sharp, measurable silhouette line.

pose: The polycotylid plesiosaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original dynamic lunge is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its long beak-like snout, compact aerodynamic torso, flippers (tucked and aligned to the camera plane), and short tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
